reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 7 points better, in a game of about 238 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Pelicans.
Bottom line: the Lakers win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 212 and 260 total points.
